name: Lifty's

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large multi-section commercial building with a dark roof and lighter flat roof sections|A large paved parking lot surrounds much of the facility|Outdoor seating and patio areas are visible, along with a prominently tall tree

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows the main building entrance area with a large parking lot in front|Outdoor seating spaces and a tall tree are visible|Landscaping and paved areas extend around the entrance

bravo.desc: The left side of the building shows parking spaces and access lanes|Outdoor patio and seating areas are visible|A tree rises above parts of the structure

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows additional building sections, outdoor areas, a roof deck and parking

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows parking and access|Outdoor areas and the tree are visible

considerations: Vehicle access is available from multiple sides via the large surrounding parking lot, which provides adequate movement throughout. Outdoor seating and patio areas create some open space around the building. Mature trees and landscaping are present but do not appear to significantly block overall site access. The layout allows relatively clear movement around the main building for emergency vehicles.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the parking areas, and are any of them gated or restricted? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the building? Are there multiple points of entry into the main building? Is vehicle access available on all sides of the facility? Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to specific areas of the site? What is the primary use of the facility?
